summary: Design, cost and assess shock-response triggers, targeting, delivery and financing. Explore practical training for social protection and cash specialists.
lede: Shock-responsive social protection links routine assistance with timely crisis support when shocks affect households. For policy officers, humanitarian programme managers and cash-transfer specialists, the course addresses how to shape a feasible response despite constraints on budgets, data and delivery capacity. Participants map activation triggers and eligibility, cost response options, document payment and grievance workflows, and use monitoring indicators to assess delivery and inform decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape or operate social assistance before, during and after a shock. It suits people who need to connect government delivery systems with humanitarian cash responses and make operational choices under budget, data and timing constraints.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to social protection, humanitarian cash assistance or programme delivery is recommended. No coding is required; basic spreadsheet use will support the costing exercise.
